svg.title: The Svjeez Gazette
svg.desc: A newspaper spins in and lands. Its blackletter masthead draws on letter by letter, the headline TYPE ARRIVES IN EVERY SVG drops in, four justified columns of text fade in line by line beside a halftone letter A, and a red EXTRA! stamp slams onto the page.

g.text: Letters draw themselves, columns justify by measure, and nothing loads from the web.
